burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Deals continuous [Fire] damage equal to 0.5% of max health to self every other second for 5 seconds.

burn2.name: Burn II
burn2.description: Deals continuous [Fire] damage equal to 1% of max health to self every other second for 5 seconds.

blind.name: Blind
blind.description: Prevent target from attacking for 3 seconds.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Creates an overshield that absorbs damage equal to a certain amount of health.

enlightened.name: Enlightened
enlightened.description: Increases attack by +15% and receives +15% damage reduction for 20 seconds.

embrace-goddess.name: Embrace of the Goddess
embrace-goddess.description: The character will revive with 20% of max health when defeated and this effect will be removed (Use Cooldown: 120 seconds for each character; Duration: 5 seconds, but +1 second per point present in any light meter)

magni-mage.name: The Magni Mage
magni-mage.description: Gain +150% mana regen and +50% Special Skill cooldown for 30 seconds.

goddess-blessing.name: Goddess' Blessing
goddess-blessing.description: Each stack gained reduces Special Skill cooldowns by -1 second once. At five stacks, heal for 5% of Avery’s max health. Remove debuffs and resets stacks.

angel-touch.name: Angel's Touch
angel-touch.description: Increase crit rate and damage by +1% per stack (Duration: 25 seconds).

rapid-recovery.name: Rapid Recovery
rapid-recovery.description: Slowly regenerate 2.5% of max health every second for 30 seconds.

ice-prince.name: Ice Prince
ice-prince.description: Gain a percentage of critical hit rate and crit damage increase equal to each point, up to 0.5% and 1% of max defense respectivaly (Stackable, Duration: 15 seconds).

shadow-miasma.name: Shadow Miasma
shadow-miasma.description: Increases [Dark] damage by +25%, increases movement speed by +100%, and +30% chance to dodge incoming attacks that would deal damage (Duration: 4 seconds).
shadow-miasma.description2: The effect will also slow opponents within 10 meters by -15% and applied element auras by self last +100% longer.

flash.name: Flash
flash.description: Increases attack and piercing by +1% per stack (Infinite Stacks).

fatigue.name: Fatigue
fatigue.description: Decreases movement speed and max stamina by -1% per stack (Infinite Stacks).

icengon.name: Icengon
icengon.description: All special skill cooldown will decrease by -50%, mana regen will increase by +150%, and energy gauge accumulation increases by +25%. This effect lasts for the duration of [Fatigue] present, losing a stack every second and cannot gain stacks during the buff.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.description: Become susceptible to critical hit damage for 2 seconds.

tinkering.name: Tinkering
tinkering.description: Crit rate increases by +25% for 15 seconds.

letm-cook.name: Let'm Cook
letm-cook.description: Upon reaching increments of 10 stacks (10, 20, etc…), Ted will gain the [Invention] effect (Infinite Stacks).

invention.name: Invention
invention.description: A specific action may occur with this effect (Infinite Stacks). Reduce movement speed by -20% per stack while this effect is active. Any gained [Shield] will give damage reduction of +30% while the effect is active.

super-shield.name: Super Shield
super-shield.description: A special shield that requires empowered attacks to break, otherwise all other incoming attacks are reduced by -75%. The shield is represented by a break bar above health and will persist until broken. If the bar is broken, the active character will be frozen for 8 seconds and will take +300% increased incoming damage during the duration.

slowness.name: Slowness
slowness.description: Decreases target’s movement speed by -70% for 3 seconds.

speed-up.name: Speed Up
speed-up.description: Increases movement speed and attack speed by +25% for 3 seconds.

mana-recovery.name: Mana Recovery
mana-recovery.description: Increase MP regeneration by +150% for 5 seconds.

magic-amplification.name: Magic Amplification
magic-amplification.description: Increases energy gauge accumulation by +40% for 15 seconds.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: When hit, decreases the attacker’s piercing by -50% on their attack.

rouge.name: Rouge
rouge.description: Consume 3% of health every second. Increase attack by +30% (Duration: 25 seconds).

jaune.name: Jaune
jaune.description: In an AoE around self, deals own element damage equal to 120% of attack (Duration: 25 seconds).

vert.name: Vert
vert.description: Recover 20% of max health once, then 3% per second (Duration: 25 seconds).

infinity-beans.name: Infinity Beans
infinity-beans.description: Gains +10% increase on all stats. Allows all effects of the individual beans to remain in effect without a duration limit. This effect has indefinite duration and cannot be removed.

indestructible.name: Indestructible
indestructible.description: Immune to the damage and health loss of attacks, status effects, and debuffs for 9 seconds.

weakened.name: Weakened
weakened.description: All elemental attacks do not have elemental advantage for 15 seconds.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: Physically change state and become a being imbued with magical energy, gaining +1500 MP as a base stat and damage increase of +20% on all Skills. Increase defense and mana regen by +100%. All attacks will inflict [Burn] on opponents. Basic Skill and normal attacks will also be infused with the [Fire] element. Dashing will deal Basic Skill Stage 3 damage on hit opponents.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.description: Incoming healing’s effectiveness increases by +100% for 10 seconds.

electrocute.name: Electrocute
electrocute.description: Lose health equal to 30% of own attack per second. Any received [Water] elemental damage will apply [Freeze] (Duration: 4 seconds).

life-drain.name: Life Drain
life-drain.description: Loses 0.5% of health per second and returns it as healing to the user who inflicted this effect (Duration: 9 seconds).

mana-drain.name: Mana Drain
mana-drain.description: Loses 0.5% of max MP per second and returns it to the user who inflicted this effect (Duration: 9 seconds).

charged.name: Charged
charged.description2: At five stacks, if having [Lightning Element] aura and next damaged by [Water] attacks, deals small AoE damage equal to 250% of the inflictor’s attack to self which is considered [Lightning Element] damage, then clear all stacks. AoE aura applies to both allies and opponents.
charged.description3: At five stacks, if having [Water] aura and hit by [Lightning Element] attack, a smaller single-hit damage is dealt to self equal to 400% of the inflictor’s attack which is considered [Lightning Element] damage, then clear all stacks.
charged.description4: The damage is increased by +15% for each level of the skill used to deal damage. The damage dealt from this effect can crit, equal to the inflictor’s crit rate and damage.
charged.description5: Damage is also further increased by +1% for each point of piercing of the inflictor.

claw-mark.name: Claw Mark
claw-mark.description: Has a 30% chance to apply this effect for 5 seconds, otherwise remove the effect. Prevent self from going more than 10 meters away from the inflictor of this effect.

invincibility.name: Invincibility
invincibility.description: Become immune to incoming damage for 6 seconds.

assassin-s-touch.name: Assassin’s Touch
assassin-s-touch.description: Attacking an opponent a single time will grant the [Marked] effect on them. When opponents hit active character, deal 25% of received damage back at them.

marked.name: Marked
marked.description: Target’s movement and direction will become reversed, lasting 3 seconds. Incoming backside attacks will deal +10% more damage. The duration of effect is dependent on self’s debuff resistance.

valiant.name: Valiant
valiant.description: Reduce incoming damage by -30% and increase movement speed by +20% for 10 seconds.

ultimate-shield.name: Ultimate Shield
ultimate-shield.description: Creates an overshield that absorbs damage equal to a certain amount of health. If any remains for more than 5 seconds, it is then converted into healing equal to the value of the shield. Gains +20% damage reduction while having this buff.

swing.name: Swing
swing.description: Extends the size of melee and ranged attacks by +30%, lasting the duration of single attack.

armor-weakness.name: Armor Weakness
armor-weakness.description: The next incoming damage is considered empowered damage, then the effect is removed.

miss.name: Miss
miss.description: Decreases crit rate by -5% for 15 seconds (Stackable, up to 10 times).

tactical-insight.name: Tactical Insight
tactical-insight.description: Gain +15% crit rate and +60% crit damage for 10 seconds.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.description: Become partially invisible (transparency) when idle and moving slowly and opponents will not spot you and engage in combat. Your first attack will deal +300% more damage.

pen-testing.name: Pen Testing
pen-testing.description: Decreases all max stats by -2% and becomes vulnerable to skills being hacked and breached with a 10% chance per stack. A chance to hack occurs when gaining a stack. Apples [Skill Disable] when hacked (Stackable up to 5, Duration: 15 seconds).

system-infiltration.name: System Infiltration
system-infiltration.description: Lose -5% of MP every other second for 10 seconds.

skill-disable.name: Skill Disable
skill-disable.description: Disables a random skill (Special or Ultimate) for 5 seconds. Reduced against higher debuff resistance.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.description: Reduces incoming attacks’ chance to crit by -10% for 15 seconds, up to 5 stacks.
